name: Malini Mohanty

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Malini Mohanty’s journal biography introduces her as a teacher from Bhubaneswar who enjoys reading novels and writing poems. Her Kabita Live contribution, Being A Girl, turns that pleasure in expression towards a confident affirmation of girlhood.

The poem’s speaker traces a life supported by family and affection, describing the freedom to choose and pursue her wishes. Its short stanzas move from remembered care to determination, then gratitude. The final wish to return to the same life gives the poem a clear, celebratory ending.
